question: Which of the following is the best-known metabolic function of the lung

options.opd: Metabolism of basic drugs by cytochrome P–450 system

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Lung" -> "presence of ACE" -> "conversion of angiotensin-I to angiotensin-II" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Lung" -> "cytochrome P-450 system" -> "metabolism of basic drugs" -> "possible" -> 50%
analysis: The lungs have several metabolic functions, but the conversion of angiotensin-I to angiotensin-II is the most well-known and significant. This conversion is catalyzed by the angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), which is abundant in the pulmonary endothelium. This process is crucial for the regulation of blood pressure and fluid balance.
